notes.material: Every opaque native pixel is sampled from source-base-v1.png; right-facing slots are whole-frame mirrors made by the cartridge sprite convention.
notes.background: The Images API returned real alpha for this sheet (the provenance file's transparentBackground:false is the generator script's fixed field), so no key-color mask is used; components and samples use the PNG's own alpha.
notes.reference: The pose guide passed as a reference is built by scripts/donkey-family-references.mjs from the stock frames this actor's event objects used. It contains original game pixels, so it is written under .local/ and only its hash is in the provenance file.
notes.palette: Twelve colors chosen by role from the twenty clusters scripts/pick-sprite-palette.mjs --clusters 20 lists for the sheet (outline, three fur greys, muzzle grey, three nightgown pinks, bonnet shade and white, eye yellow), snapped to SNES 15-bit. Written to palette 13, the private row this actor owns.
notes.roles: Cells 13 and 14 are the rear and front passing steps of the four-phase walks; cell 15 (pointing) has no native slot and is not compiled.
notes.placement: bottom 31 puts the feet on the source actor's ground line; cells 11 and 12 (arms up) are scaled to 0.94 to stay inside the 32-pixel cell.
